newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV sees 1996 earnings, dividend up.
newsitem.headline: OMV sees 1996 earnings, dividend up.

text.p: Austrian oil group OMV said on Tuesday it planned to raise its 1996 dividend from last year's 20 schillings and forecast double digit percentage growth in full year pre-tax profit and earnings before interest and tax (EBIT).
"There will certainly be a double digit (percentage) increase in EBIT and pre-tax for 1996," finance director Wolfgang Ruttenstorfer told a news conference.
He declined to say how much OMV would increase its dividend but said it was unlikely to match the expected profit rise.
Last year Austria's biggest industrial group posted a record pre-tax profit of 2.09 billion schillings and an EBIT of 2.19 billion. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
